svg.title: First Light · Commit calendar for hyyyyyyz
svg.desc: 1,712 public commit contributions from 2025-11-19 through 2026-11-18. A Franka Panda holds Gaia’s Vengeance Vandal on a fixed pedestal. Each lit date fades on impact. A gold pennant rises beside the base after the last date goes dark.
svg.metadata: Franka Panda geometry via MuJoCo Menagerie, Apache-2.0. First Light illustration and choreography by Antikythera. Gaia Vandal (Red) by ILilMitch, https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/gaia-vandal-red-dfeddd540e7641bfb0b7128155117a1d (CC BY 4.0, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Captured from the 3D model and vectorized by Antikythera. Underlying VALORANT artwork © Riot Games. Personal fan illustration under https://www.riotgames.com/en/legal.
